name: One Thousand Voices

frame.name: Ahamkara's Eye
frame.description: Charging this weapon unleashes a giant continuous beam of death.

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.description:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Liquid Coils
perks.description:
Slower-building charge for higher damage.
  •  Increases impact damage
  •  Slower charge time

perks.name: Unforeseen Repercussions
perks.description: This weapon's beam superheats its targets upon impact, causing delayed scorching explosions.

perks.name: Fitted Stock
perks.description:
This stock makes the weapon stable but heavy
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

flavor: I can be anyone you wish, o murderer mine.

catalyst.name: One Thousand Voices Catalyst
catalyst.description: The weapon has become partially Taken. Detonations produce Taken energy that aggressively seeks out nearby targets and Blights them.
